summary: Prepare ESG disclosures for assurance with GRI Standards, ISSA 5000, evidence logs, and control matrices. Join TrainingCred and strengthen reporting credibility
lede: Assurance readiness for sustainability reporting helps reporting, finance, and audit professionals prepare disclosures and supporting evidence for external review. The practical work includes mapping control ownership, tracing data lineage, validating emissions and workforce metrics, and maintaining evidence records. Learners also practice coordinating stakeholder sign-off, managing review comments, and tracking gaps through a remediation plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support sustainability reporting and now need to prepare for external assurance, tighten controls, and improve the quality of evidence behind ESG disclosures.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work in spreadsheets and shared document folders. Prior experience with sustainability reporting, internal control, or assurance preparation will help you move faster through the exercises.
